summary.text: William Sommer is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Lucy McVitty Weber.

paragraphs.text: Sommer ran for the same seat in 2024, when Lucy McVitty Weber defeated him in the general election.
